title: A new market-data source
conventions: implement RetrievalSource from retrieval/sources.py (name, tier, dataTypes, available, retrieve)
retrieve() must never raise — return a SourceOutcome with status UNAVAILABLE when it has no data
the planner selects a source by data type; add the DataType to retrieval/contract.py when it is new
acceptance: the source is available when configured, returns UNAVAILABLE (never a guess) when it has no data, and declares the data type it serves
